BL-1363 — Closing a ticket is hand-made while promoting one is a script: 409 hand-built close commits against 484 generated promotion commits, and the done area has drifted into 665 loose files beside 516 in milestone directories
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-03 by the specifier during the operator-directed sweep for
repeatable agentic tasks. Ranked third of the opportunities found; the full
inventory is on BL-667.
Approval context: One decision is yours, posed as ruling_options below, and it is about existing history rather than the script. . Closes have been landing in two different places for months - 665 ticket files sit loose in `backlog/done/` and 516 more sit in milestone subdirectories. A close script has to pick one. …
BL-1363 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1363" (or "reject BL-1363 <reason>") to act.
